newsitem.title: USA: Fujisawa gets FDA PROGRAF okay for kidneys.
newsitem.headline: Fujisawa gets FDA PROGRAF okay for kidneys.

text.p: Fujisawa USA Inc said Friday it received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance to market its PROGRAF drug for kidney transplant patients.
Fujisawa, a unit of Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co Ltd of Osaka, said the drug has been available in the United States since 1994 for patients receiving liver transplants.
Fujisawa said it received the clearance on April 22.
PROGRAF helps prevent organ rejection in transplant patients. The company said about 70 percent of liver transplant patients receive the drug.

"We believe it holds similar promise for the approximately 11,000 patients annually who undergo kidney transplantation in this country," Noboru Maeda, president and chief executive of Fujisawa USA, said in a statement.
Fujisawa said PROGRAF is also marketed for use in kidney transplant patients in Japan, Britain, Ireland and Austria.
